info.title: dotnet-archive
info.description: .NET global tool designed to package and run framework-dependent .NET applications as a single-file portable archive with a .dna extension.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: DotNet Archive Utility — package, run, and inspect .NET applications as portable .dna archives.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: export
commands.description: Compile a .NET project and pack it into a .dna archive.

options.name: --output
options.description: Destination path for the .dna output file.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Target runtime identifier (e.g. linux-x64, win-x64, osx-arm64).

options.name: --self-contained
options.description: Bundle a portable .NET runtime into the archive (increases size). [default: False]

options.name: --compression
options.description: ZIP compression level: Optimal | Fastest | NoCompression (default Optimal). [default: Optimal]

options.name: --include
options.description: Glob pattern(s) of files to include (can be repeated). If unset, all files are included.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Glob pattern(s) of files to exclude (can be repeated).

options.name: --manifest-field
options.description: Add a custom field to the manifest, as KEY=VALUE. Repeatable.

arguments.name: PROJECT
arguments.description: Path to a .csproj file or a project directory (default: current directory). [default: <path>]

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute a packaged .dna archive or compile-and-run a project.

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Extract the archive to a temporary directory and clean it up afterwards. [default: False]

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variable to pass to the application, as KEY=VALUE. Repeatable.

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Working directory for the spawned process (default: the archive's extraction dir).

arguments.name: ARCHIVE
arguments.description: Path to a .dna archive, a .csproj file, or a project directory (default: current directory). [default: <path>]

arguments.name: APP_ARGS
arguments.description: Arguments forwarded to the application (use -- to separate from tool flags). [default: System.String[]]

commands.name: register
commands.description: Associate the .dna file extension with this tool on the current OS.

commands.name: unregister
commands.description: Remove the .dna file association from this tool.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show manifest and contents of a .dna archive.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

arguments.name: ARCHIVE
arguments.description: Path to the .dna archive to inspect.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a .dna archive is intact and has a valid manifest.

arguments.name: ARCHIVE
arguments.description: Path to the .dna archive to verify.

commands.name: cache
commands.description: Manage the on-disk cache of extracted .dna archives.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all entries currently in the cache.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove old or excess cache entries.

options.name: --older-than
options.description: Remove entries older than N days.

options.name: --keep
options.description: Keep at most N most-recently-accessed entries.

commands.name: set-dir
commands.description: Change the cache directory used by the tool.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the dotnet-archive version and exit.
